title: ONE TILE SIZE ON EVERY RACK
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): make the menus look like a AAA game, checked in pictures. In Fashion the rack tiles were narrow, so eight outfits left a third of the rack empty and a long requirement broke into three lines, and the tiles were a different height on every rack. The tiles are wider now, eight fill the rack, and every tile on every rack is the same height.
now: Fashion rack tiles are one size on every rack and fill the rack width.
